**Q: How long does delivery take ?**
A: Delivery takes 2 or 3 business days

**Q: How do I return an order ?**
A: Just use the return slip in the box we sent you

**Q: Are your products cruelty-free ?**
A: Yes, Serein Studio stands against animal testing

**Q: Are the products vegan ?**
A: Most of our products are vegan. Check the label for details

**Q: Are the products fragrance-free ?**
A: Yes, all our products are fragrance-free

**Q: Is it possible to test your products before buying them ?**
A: Yes ! We can send you samples

**Q: Should I do a patch test before using a new product ?**
A: Yes, we recommend applying a small amount on your inner arm and waiting 24 hours before full use
